# Set Weapon

Source: [4484](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4484); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Set Weapon](../../api/actions/set-weapon.md).

<a id="wiki-4484-n1"></a>

- Set Weapon cannot select a weapon disabled in settings.

<a id="wiki-4484-n2"></a>

- Weapon numbering is 1 for first, 2 for second; nonexistent weapons select the default weapon.
